scope: One real-model integration check only; zero parameter/optimizer/EMA updates; not M/P training or an enhancement experiment
crop_policy: fixed center crop for both preflight records; no event or sample reselection
preservation: source checkpoint, six selected audio files, three main source files, loaded model parameters and buffers before/after; no source writes
failure_policy: exclusive start marker and output; record failure, never automatic retry or architecture/precision/determinism fallback
gradient_scale_probe: One autograd.grad(pair,dnn,retain_graph=True) and one total P backward on the same four Score forwards; record norm(pair), norm(M)=norm(total-P_weight*pair_grad), norm(total), and effective pair-to-M ratio. No optimizer/EMA/parameter updates and no hyperparameter search.
